key_provisions_or_claims: GB/T 45312-2025 is a recommended national standard on operational design conditions (ODC) for automated driving systems.
Administered by TC114/SC34 under the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology.
Drafted by automakers, Huawei, DJI and universities.
Page shows metadata only, with related standards such as GB 44721 and GB 44497.
annotation.summary_en: National Standards Information Public Service Platform page for China's recommended national standard GB/T 45312-2025, defining operational design conditions for automated driving systems in intelligent connected vehicles. Shows only metadata: issuing bodies, drafters, dates (2025-02-28) and related standards; the standard text is not reproduced.
